one_line_answer.text: The context of assessment is the environment or setting of the assessment activity.

cites.quote: The context of assessment is the environment or setting in which the assessment activity takes place.

keywords.bn: জায়গা, যন্ত্রপাতি, আলো-বাতাস ইত্যাদি বাস্তব পরিবেশ

bangla_explanation: Context মানে assessment কোথায় আর কোন পরিবেশে হচ্ছে, সেই setting।
এর মধ্যে physical environment আর social environment দুটোই পড়ে।
Units of competency-র সাথে candidate-এর real work-এর সম্পর্ক, আর time period-ও context-এর অংশ।
আগে থেকে এগুলো ঠিক করে রাখলে assessment ঠিকমতো, expected ভাবে হয়।

example.en: A motor mechanic is assessed in a real garage workshop. The tools and space are the physical environment. The co-workers are the social environment. The test lasts one day.
example.bn: গ্যারেজের যন্ত্র ও জায়গা = physical, সহকর্মীরা = social, এক দিন = time period।

items_bn: Assessment কোন পরিবেশে হবে — physical environment (জায়গা) আর social environment (মানুষজন ও পরিস্থিতি) দুটোই।
Units of competency-র সাথে candidate-এর real work-এর কী সম্পর্ক, তা দেখা হয়।
Assessment কত সময় ধরে চলবে — সেই time period-ও context-এর অংশ।

traps.text: Environment has two parts: physical environment and social environment.

traps.text: It is not necessary to notify everyone who has some interest.

short.prompt: What is the context of assessment? What may it include?
short.modelAnswer:
The context of assessment is the environment or setting where the assessment activity takes place. It may include:
1. The environment where assessment is carried out (physical and social)
2. The relationship between units of competency and the candidate's real work
3. The time period over which assessment takes place

keyPoints.text: Circumstances are prepared prior to assessment so it takes place as expected.

cites.quote: A combination of circumstances may be prepared and established prior to the assessment as this will ensure that the assessment process will take place as expected.

keyPoints.text: Contact the person who trained your candidates and the training supervisor/coordinator.

cites.quote: Some people you may need to contact include:
the person/s who trained your candidates;
the training supervisor/coordinator of the organization

keyPoints.text: Also contact people managing the resources and office staff at the venue.

cites.quote: people responsible for managing the resources you require to conduct the assessment
office staff at the assessment venue/center.
